astronomy_picture_of_the_day.title: Turtle Rock on Mars
astronomy_picture_of_the_day.explanation: Is this a fossilized turtle on Mars?  No.  Although resembling a large Earth tortoise, this is a layered rock outcrop on Mars that is estimated to span about 15 meters, making it much larger than turtles on Earth.
